none: PAS NLM-6EA326: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian I (364-375), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19, probably Lyon mint. Obverse description: Bust draped and rosette diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]NVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive; the emperor walks rather than high-steps. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. In exergue: LV[?]. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.62gms, die axis: 6
